description: HTML file containing a Leaflet map example with buttons to add markers, circles, lines, and polygons, along with map initialization and event handling scripts.

methods.name: getRandomLatLng
methods.description: Generates a random latitude and longitude within given map bounds.

methods.name: populateMarker
methods.description: Adds 5 random markers within map bounds.

methods.name: populateCircle
methods.description: Adds 5 random circle markers within map bounds.

methods.name: populateLine
methods.description: Creates a polyline with 10 random points within map bounds.

methods.name: populatePoly
methods.description: Creates a polygon with 10 random points within map bounds.
